sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: So, what do they do?
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: Well, when you lose your sugar daddy, you've got to get yourself another one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当你失去了你的“糖爹”，你就得再找一个。

sentences.en: So, when the Soviet Union fell, they started relying on Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 所以，当苏联解体后，他们开始依赖委内瑞拉。

sentences.en: Venezuela kept them afloat for almost 25 years.
sentences.zh: 委内瑞拉维持了他们近25年的生存。

sentences.en: The other thing they did was open to tourism.
sentences.zh: 他们做的另一件事是开放旅游业。

sentences.en: So, if you'll allow me to jump forward in time a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果允许我稍微跳跃一下时间线的话。

sentences.en: President Obama decides that he's going to try the exact opposite of what everybody else tried.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统决定尝试与所有人之前尝试过的完全相反的做法。

sentences.en: You know, so everybody else is trying to suffocate Cuba to get them to fold.
sentences.zh: 你知道，其他人都在试图窒息古巴，迫使他们屈服。

sentences.en: He's like, you know what?
sentences.zh: 而他却想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: We're going to do the opposite.
sentences.zh: 我们要反其道而行之。

sentences.en: We're going to let people visit.
sentences.zh: 我们要让人们去访问。

sentences.en: We're going to let, you know, private businesses get licenses to do business there.
sentences.zh: 我们要让，你知道，私营企业获得在那里开展业务的许可。

sentences.en: They were hoping that the opening of Cuba will allow it to fall.
sentences.zh: 他们当时希望古巴的开放能导致其政权倒台。

sentences.en: We'll get all the Cubans on the island to say, wait a second, you mean there's an internet?
sentences.zh: 我们会让岛上所有的古巴人说，等一下，你是说还有互联网？

sentences.en: There's cell phones?
sentences.zh: 还有手机？

sentences.en: You know, I want a piece of that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我也想分一杯羹。

sentences.en: And so, from about, let's say, 2015, 16, 17, you see this big boom in tourism.
sentences.zh: 所以，从大概2015、16、17年左右开始，你看到了旅游业的巨大繁荣。

sentences.en: And that's another point where people think, oh, yeah,
sentences.zh: 这也是人们认为“哦，是的”的另一个节点，

sentences.en: now the Cuban government is really going to end because there's no way that people in Cuba will see how the rest of the world lives and be able to stick it out with this government.
sentences.zh: 现在古巴政府真的要完了，因为古巴人不可能在看到世界其他地方的生活方式后，还能继续忍受这个政府。

sentences.en: The idea from the Obama administration at the time was, okay, sticks have not worked in Cuba for, like, half a century, so we should try something else.
sentences.zh: 当时奥巴马政府的想法是，好吧，大棒政策在古巴已经行不通半个世纪了，所以我们应该尝试点别的。

sentences.en: And that something else should be exposing Cubans to the benefits of capitalism.
sentences.zh: 而那个“别的”应该是让古巴人接触到资本主义的好处。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: It didn't exactly work because the Cuban government saw it as a Trojan horse, and they put up a lot of obstacles to that opening.
sentences.zh: 但这并没有完全奏效，因为古巴政府将其视为特洛伊木马，并为这种开放设置了许多障碍。

sentences.en: So, other than a few years of a lot of tourism, the economic opening never really happened.
sentences.zh: 所以，除了几年大量的旅游业发展外，经济开放从未真正实现。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But when Trump comes along, he basically says, okay, well, that's enough of that.
sentences.zh: 但当特朗普上台后，他基本上说，好吧，够了。

sentences.en: You know, so he reverses just about everything that President Obama had done.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他推翻了奥巴马总统所做的一切。

sentences.en: You know, and he puts back in travel restrictions, restrictions on sending money to Cuba, restrictions on doing business there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他恢复了旅行限制、汇款限制，以及在当地经商的限制。

sentences.en: And he takes things very much back to the traditional Republican, we're going to choke these people until they fold strategy.
sentences.zh: 他把一切又带回了传统的共和党策略，即“我们要扼杀这些人直到他们屈服”。

sentences.en: So, back to sticks, basically.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上又回到了大棒政策。

sentences.en: Back to sticks.
sentences.zh: 回到大棒政策。

sentences.en: That was always going to be Trump's plan.
sentences.zh: 那一直都是特朗普的计划。

sentences.en: And what's interesting is, you know, the Trump administration ended, Biden took his place, and he didn't change that much, to be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，你知道，特朗普政府结束了，拜登接替了他，老实说，他并没有做出太大改变。

sentences.en: A lot of these measures stayed in place.
sentences.zh: 许多这些措施都保留了下来。

sentences.en: But then Trump won again.
sentences.zh: 但后来特朗普又赢了。

sentences.en: And you get the sense that this administration decided, this is our shot.
sentences.zh: 你会感觉到这届政府认为，这是我们的机会。

sentences.en: That this is going to be the administration that succeeds where so many before them failed.
sentences.zh: 这将是那个在许多前任失败的地方取得成功的政府。

sentences.en: And what they've done has really brought the Cuban government to its worst crisis that it's suffered in its 67 years in existence.
sentences.zh: 而他们所做的一切，确实将古巴政府推向了其存在67年来最严重的危机。

sentences.en: Its future has never been more precarious.
sentences.zh: 它的未来从未如此岌岌可危。

sentences.zh: 休息之后，我们将与我的同事迈克尔·克劳利一起深入探讨特朗普政府的战略。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.zh: 我是马克·朗森。

sentences.en: So, Michael,
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克尔，

sentences.en: our colleague Frenchy Robles just told us that the Cuban regime is more vulnerable than it's ever been because of the policies that the Trump administration has carried out.
sentences.zh: 我们的同事弗兰奇·罗伯斯刚刚告诉我们，由于特朗普政府实施的政策，古巴政权比以往任何时候都更加脆弱。

sentences.en: You cover the administration's foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 你负责报道该政府的外交政策。

sentences.en: So take me inside that story.
sentences.zh: 带我深入了解一下这个故事。

sentences.en: What are you seeing?
sentences.zh: 你看到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, this is very much by design.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很大程度上是刻意为之的。

sentences.en: The Trump administration until now has not talked a lot about Cuba but has always had big plans for Cuba.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府到目前为止虽然没有过多谈论古巴，但一直对古巴有宏大的计划。

sentences.en: And I think it's important to understand how much this is coming from Marco Rubio.
sentences.zh: 我认为理解这在多大程度上源于马可·鲁比奥是很重要的。

sentences.en: Rubio is driving this.
sentences.zh: 鲁比奥正在推动这一切。

sentences.en: And we may be approaching an endgame that Rubio has worked towards for decades now.
sentences.zh: 我们可能正在接近鲁比奥几十年来一直致力于实现的终局。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So Rubio is absolutely central, you're saying.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，鲁比奥是绝对的核心。

sentences.en: Why is this his singular obsession?
sentences.zh: 为什么这是他唯一的执念？

sentences.en: Just tell me what his motivations are.
sentences.zh: 告诉我他的动机是什么。

sentences.en: You know, let's start with his background and origins.
sentences.zh: 你知道，让我们从他的背景和出身说起。

sentences.en: Rubio is Cuban-American.
sentences.zh: 鲁比奥是古巴裔美国人。

sentences.en: His parents fled to the United States from Cuba before Castro took power in 1959 but were very strongly anti-Castro.
sentences.zh: 他的父母在卡斯特罗1959年掌权前逃往美国，但他们是非常坚定的反卡斯特罗派。

sentences.en: So Rubio grows up in a community of Cuban exiles.
sentences.zh: 所以鲁比奥是在一个古巴流亡者社区中长大的。

sentences.en: And he makes it really his signature issue as he dives into the politics of South Florida where Cuban exiles who are vituperatively opposed to the Cuban regime have enormous influence.
sentences.zh: 当他投身于南佛罗里达州的政治时，他将此作为自己的标志性议题，在那里，那些对古巴政权深恶痛绝的古巴流亡者拥有巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: And Rubio has made his opposition to the Cuban government and his efforts to promote its overthrow central to his political identity for his entire career.
sentences.zh: 鲁比奥在他整个职业生涯中，都将反对古巴政府及其推动政权更迭的努力作为其政治身份的核心。

sentences.en: And maybe the most vivid detail to underscore that is when Rubio himself ran for president in 2016.
sentences.zh: 也许最能强调这一点的生动细节是鲁比奥本人在2016年竞选总统时。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: He announced his campaign at what is known as the Freedom Tower in Miami.
sentences.zh: 他在迈阿密著名的自由塔宣布了他的竞选活动。

sentences.en: In this very room, five decades ago, tens of thousands of Cuban exiles began their new lives in America.
sentences.zh: 就在这个房间里，五十年前，成千上万的古巴流亡者开始了他们在美利坚的新生活。

sentences.en: Which was the first stop for those Cuban refugees to sort of announce their arrival in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这是那些古巴难民宣布他们抵达美国的第一站。

sentences.en: And if America once again accepts the mantle of global leadership by ending the near total disregard for the erosion of democracy and human rights around the world,
sentences.zh: 如果美国再次承担起全球领导的责任，结束对世界各地民主和人权遭到侵蚀的近乎完全的漠视，

sentences.en: especially Cuba, Venezuela, Nicaragua.
sentences.zh: 特别是古巴、委内瑞拉和尼加拉瓜。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: You're saying his career was forged inside this Cuban-American community that Frenchie told us this as well has been both powerful and very keen on toppling the Castro regime.
sentences.zh: 你是说他的职业生涯是在这个古巴裔美国人社区中锻造出来的，弗兰奇也告诉过我们，这个群体既强大又非常渴望推翻卡斯特罗政权。

sentences.en: This is Rubio.
sentences.zh: 这就是鲁比奥。

sentences.en: This is his people.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的人民。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is at the core of his personal and political identity.
sentences.zh: 这是他个人和政治身份的核心。

sentences.en: And I think that for him, possibly even more than for President Trump,
sentences.zh: 我认为对他来说，可能比对特朗普总统来说更甚，

sentences.en: getting rid of the current Cuban government would be a sort of crowning legacy achievement that would make him feel like his political career had all been worth it.
sentences.zh: 除掉当前的古巴政府将是一种加冕般的遗产成就，会让他觉得自己的政治生涯一切都值了。

sentences.en: It's all been kind of working toward this if he can get it.
sentences.zh: 如果他能做到的话，这一切似乎都是朝着这个目标努力的。

sentences.en: And obviously now he has the reins of U.S.
sentences.zh: 显然，现在他作为国务卿、国家安全顾问，掌握着美国外交政策的缰绳。

sentences.en: foreign policy as Secretary of State, as National Security Advisor.
sentences.zh: 所以你是如何看到这对他的影响的？

sentences.en: So how have you seen this play out for him?
sentences.zh: 那么，你已经看到了特朗普政府对西半球，特别是拉丁美洲的这种令人难以置信的关注。

sentences.en: Well, you've seen this incredible focus by the Trump administration on the Western Hemisphere and in particular Latin America.
sentences.zh: 鲁比奥确实带头推动了特朗普政府对委内瑞拉领导人尼古拉斯·马杜罗的压力，这最终导致了马杜罗在1月初被捕。

sentences.en: And Rubio really spearheaded the Trump administration's pressure on Venezuela's leader, Nicolas Maduro, which ultimately led to Maduro's capture in early January.
sentences.zh: 现在，这实际上直接指向了我们正在讨论的古巴问题。

sentences.en: Now, this actually goes straight to the Cuba question that we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我从我的报道中得知，鲁比奥在推翻马杜罗和推翻古巴政府之间建立了非常明确的联系。

sentences.en: I know from my reporting that Rubio has made a very explicit connection between bringing down Maduro and bringing down the Cuban government.
sentences.zh: 人们认为委内瑞拉和古巴在过去几十年里成为了非常亲密的盟友。

sentences.en: The thinking is that Venezuela and Cuba became very close allies over the past few decades.
sentences.zh: 古巴为委内瑞拉人提供了军事训练和情报。

sentences.en: The Cubans provided Venezuelans with military training and intelligence.
sentences.zh: 而委内瑞拉则向古巴运送了大量的石油。

sentences.en: And the Venezuelans were shipping large amounts of oil to Cuba.
sentences.zh: 古巴没有太多的石油供应来源。

sentences.en: Cuba doesn't have a lot of oil suppliers.
sentences.zh: 所以鲁比奥的算盘是，如果你能除掉马杜罗并切断那些运往哈瓦那的古巴石油供应，

sentences.en: So Rubio's calculus was if you can get rid of Maduro and cut off those Cuban oil supplies to Havana,
sentences.zh: 那将是一个巨大的打击，让你离推翻古巴政府更近了一步。

sentences.en: that is a huge blow that brings you a lot closer to bringing down the Cuban government.
sentences.zh: 你是说鲁比奥想赶走马杜罗，因为他显然不支持这个政权。

sentences.en: You're saying that Rubio wanted to oust Maduro because he's not in favor of this regime, obviously.
sentences.zh: 但他也认为这是削弱古巴的一种方式。

sentences.en: But also he sees this as a way of weakening Cuba.
sentences.zh: 弗兰奇告诉我们，古巴已经开始依赖委内瑞拉的石油。

sentences.en: Frenchie had told us that Cuba had come to rely on Venezuela for oil.
sentences.zh: 所以通过控制委内瑞拉的石油，鲁比奥认为他可以直接影响古巴政权。

sentences.en: And so by getting control of Venezuela's oil, Rubio thinks that he can directly impact the Cuban regime.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 我认为对鲁比奥来说，目前委内瑞拉发生的事情最重要的一点是，我们已经迫使委内瑞拉停止向古巴运送石油。

sentences.en: I think for Rubio, probably the most important thing about what's happening in Venezuela right now is that we have forced Venezuela to stop shipping oil to Cuba.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 失去这样一个关键的近邻盟友和石油供应国，对古巴人来说是一个重大的事态发展，也是一个非常糟糕的消息。

sentences.en: And to lose such a key nearby ally and an oil supplier in Venezuela is a major development and a really bad one for the Cubans.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，特朗普政府正在向其他国家施压，要求它们不要介入并拯救古巴人。

sentences.en: On top of that, the Trump administration is pressuring other countries to not step in and come to the rescue of the Cubans.
sentences.zh: 1月底，特朗普总统发布了一项行政命令，威胁要对任何向古巴供应石油的国家征收关税。

sentences.en: And in late January, President Trump issued an executive order threatening tariffs against any country that supplied Cuba with oil.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们已经看到了对古巴政府的又一次重大打击，那就是墨西哥总统表示她已经暂停了对该岛的石油运输。

sentences.en: So now we have already seen another major blow for the Cuban government, which is that the president of Mexico has said that she has suspended oil shipments to the island.
sentences.zh: 而墨西哥最近实际上已经取代委内瑞拉成为该岛最大的供应国。

sentences.en: And Mexico had actually overtaken Venezuela recently as the island's top supplier.
sentences.zh: 所以这是今年第二个停止向古巴政府运送石油的主要供应国。

sentences.en: So that's the second major supplier to the Cuban government that has stopped sending oil just this year.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 这对古巴政权来说是一个重大的损失。

sentences.en: It's just a major loss for the Cuban regime.
sentences.zh: 作为曾在那里担任分社社长并报道过墨西哥的人，我可以肯定地说，总统克劳迪娅·辛鲍姆做出这个决定一定是一个极其痛苦的时刻。

sentences.en: And having covered Mexico as the bureau chief there, I can say that the president, Claudia Sheinbaum, just it must have been an incredibly wrenching moment for her.
sentences.zh: 她是左翼人士，是左翼父母的女儿。

sentences.en: She's a leftiSt. She's the daughter of left-wing parents.
sentences.zh: 她一直直言不讳地支持古巴政府。

sentences.en: She's been an outspoken supporter of the Cuban government.
sentences.zh: 我可以想象她面对这种情况，真的是进退两难。

sentences.en: And I can imagine she's looking at this situation where she's really between a rock and a hard place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，特朗普在这里并没有给她或任何国家太多选择。

sentences.en: I mean, Trump's not giving her or any country much of a choice here.
sentences.zh: 你说得完全正确。

sentences.en: You're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们今天看到的是现实，即美国的经济实力，

sentences.en: But I think what we're seeing is the reality today that American economic might,
sentences.zh: 加上特朗普总统愿意以其他总统未曾使用过的方式运用这种经济力量。

sentences.en: coupled with President Trump's willingness to use that economic power in ways that other presidents have not.
sentences.zh: 然后我认为，古巴革命和菲德尔·卡斯特罗的光环，以及他对拉丁美洲人民的影响，正在经历漫长而缓慢的消退，

sentences.en: And then I think this long, slow dimming of the glamour of the Cuban revolution and Fidel Castro and the impact he had on people around Latin America,
sentences.zh: 我认为这可能比一代人之前更容易实现。

sentences.en: I think that it's probably a little more doable than it was, say, a generation ago.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 卡斯特罗家族已不再掌权。

sentences.en: The Castros are no longer in power.
sentences.zh: 革命已经过去很久了。

sentences.en: It's been a long time since the revolution.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，岛上的情况也发生了变化。

sentences.en: I mean, things have changed on the island, too.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这把我们带到了今天，这项政策现在确实让古巴陷入了极其困难的境地，

sentences.en: So I think that brings us to the present day, where this policy has now really put Cuba in this extremely difficult situation,
sentences.zh: 当地的情况非常严峻，没有石油输入，这个岛屿似乎正处于全面人道主义危机的边缘。

sentences.en: where conditions on the ground are just very dire, no oil is coming in, and this island seems close to an all-out humanitarian crisis.
sentences.zh: 我的问题是，在马可·鲁比奥和特朗普总统看来，如何从人道主义危机过渡到政权更迭？

sentences.en: My question is, how in the minds of Marco Rubio and President Trump do you get from a humanitarian crisis to regime change?
sentences.zh: 就像，那里的计算是什么？

sentences.en: Like, what's the calculation there?
sentences.zh: 这并不容易。

sentences.en: It's not easy.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，老实说，我不确定他们是否完全想清楚了，因为没有简单的方法来做到这一点。

sentences.en: And, you know, honestly, it's not clear to me that they have it entirely figured out, because there's just not a simple way to do this.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很明显，鲁比奥特别希望看到这个政权倒台并被扫进历史的垃圾堆。

sentences.en: You know, it's very clear that Rubio in particular wants to see this regime brought down and consigned to the dustbin of history.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我认为鲁比奥也意识到，由于种种原因，这不是一朝一夕能做到的。

sentences.en: But at the same time, I think Rubio recognizes that this is not something you can do overnight for a bunch of reasons.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，其中之一就是它伴随着真正的风险。

sentences.en: And, you know, one of them is that it comes with real risks.
sentences.zh: 我在报道中一直在与许多密切关注古巴的人交谈。

sentences.en: I've been talking in my reporting to a lot of people who track Cuba extremely closely.
sentences.zh: 我一直在与许多密切关注古巴的人交谈。

sentences.en: And, you know, what they warn is that this is a monolithic, brittle, political system.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他们警告说这是一个单一、脆弱且僵化的政治体制。

sentences.en: There's no political opposition because the government there has been repressive for so long.
sentences.zh: 那里没有政治反对派，因为政府长期以来一直实行高压统治。

sentences.en: It's going to be really hard to find some kind of an opposition leader who could take over, or even to do some kind of a short-term transition to a different government.
sentences.zh: 要找到一个能接管政权的反对派领导人，甚至进行某种向不同政府的短期过渡，都将非常困难。

sentences.en: And if you bring down the entire government without something to replace it, you risk total chaos, violence, mass migration from Cuba toward Florida,
sentences.zh: 如果你在没有替代方案的情况下推翻整个政府，你将面临彻底混乱、暴力以及从古巴向佛罗里达的大规模移民的风险，

sentences.en: a lot of conditions that would put the Trump administration in a very uncomfortable position of having to make choices about what they do next.
sentences.zh: 这些情况会让特朗普政府陷入非常尴尬的境地，不得不对下一步行动做出选择。

sentences.en: So the question is, is there a way that you can kind of engineer a soft landing?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是，有没有办法实现所谓的“软着陆”？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: What would that look like, Michael?
sentences.zh: 那会是什么样子呢，迈克尔？

sentences.en: A soft landing.
sentences.zh: 软着陆。

sentences.en: I am wondering what the best-case scenario the Trump administration imagines here.
sentences.zh: 我想知道特朗普政府在这里设想的最佳方案是什么。

sentences.en: Like, are they looking to find a partner within the Cuban regime that they could work with to kind of negotiate change?
sentences.zh: 比如，他们是否在寻找古巴政权内部的合作伙伴，以便通过谈判实现变革？

sentences.en: Someone like Delce Rodriguez in Venezuela, the former vice president, to Maduro, who's now leading the country and working with the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 就像委内瑞拉前副总统德尔西·罗德里格斯（Delce Rodriguez）那样，她曾辅佐马杜罗，现在领导国家并与美国合作？

sentences.en: Is that the best case here?
sentences.zh: 这是最好的情况吗？

sentences.en: Well, it could be, but the experts that I talk to say, in the words of one of them, it's a fool's errand to try to find Delce Rodriguez in Cuba.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有可能是，但我交谈过的专家们说，用其中一位的话说，试图在古巴找到“德尔西·罗德里格斯”简直是痴人说梦。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because of the nature of their political system, number one, it's very unlikely that you would have somebody who was willing to kind of step out of the political culture
sentences.zh: 首先，由于他们政治体制的本质，你很难找到一个愿意跳出这种政治文化的人，

sentences.en: and allow themselves to be seen as a sort of American puppet.
sentences.zh: 并允许自己被视为某种美国傀儡。

sentences.en: At least in Venezuela, you have a substantial part of the population that has some sympathy for the United States.
sentences.zh: 至少在委内瑞拉，你有相当一部分民众对美国抱有同情。

sentences.en: But there's just going to be very little of that in Cuba.
sentences.zh: 但在古巴，这种情况微乎其微。

sentences.en: The other problem is that it's a question of what you would want from the Cubans.
sentences.zh: 另一个问题是，你到底想从古巴人那里得到什么。

sentences.en: And Rubio gave an interview over the weekend that gave us some clues as to what they might be thinking.
sentences.zh: 卢比奥周末接受采访时透露了一些他们可能在考虑的事情。

sentences.en: And he said that it's really important that Cuba's government agree to some significant changes to its state-run socialist economy.
sentences.zh: 他说，古巴政府同意对其国有社会主义经济进行重大改革非常重要。

sentences.en: He really emphasized the economy over the political system.
sentences.zh: 他确实强调了经济重于政治体制。

sentences.en: But he has made clear many times over the years that other deals the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但他多年来多次明确表示，美国与古巴政府达成的其他协议，

sentences.en: has struck with the Cuban government, which in his view have led to very incremental reforms, were almost worse than nothing.
sentences.zh: 在他看来只带来了非常微小的改革，几乎还不如什么都不做。

sentences.en: You know, Rubio's reaction is that that's the Cuban government being dishonest, playing for time, making promises it has no intention of keeping and eventually reneging on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，卢比奥的反应是，那是古巴政府在不诚实，在拖延时间，做出根本不打算遵守的承诺，最终还会背信弃义。

sentences.en: Well, and to be fair, it's true that this regime is absolutely expert in buying time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，平心而论，这个政权确实非常擅长争取时间。

sentences.en: That is what they have done over and over again.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们一次又一次所做的事情。

sentences.en: This is a pattern, a well-established pattern.
sentences.zh: 这是一种模式，一种根深蒂固的模式。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So that leaves you with a situation where it looks like the Cuban government would have to essentially agree to its own demise to get Trump off its back.
sentences.zh: 所以这就导致了一种局面：古巴政府似乎必须本质上同意自我终结，才能让特朗普不再找麻烦。

sentences.en: And that seems very unlikely.
sentences.zh: 而这看起来极不可能。

sentences.en: I mean, it's basically suicidal.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这基本上是自杀。

sentences.en: Again, you know, I'm talking to many people who have followed the Cuban leadership over the years, and they say that they just can't imagine that happening.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我和许多多年来一直关注古巴领导层的人交谈过，他们说他们根本无法想象这种情况发生。

sentences.en: Now, at the same time, if this economy and society is totally collapsing around them, and who knows, maybe at some point you start having popular protests,
sentences.zh: 不过与此同时，如果经济和社会在他们周围彻底崩溃，谁知道呢，也许在某个时候你会开始看到民众抗议，

sentences.en: that could convince them to make a deal like that.
sentences.zh: 那可能会说服他们达成那样的协议。

sentences.en: But that's a very extreme situation.
sentences.zh: 但这是一种非常极端的情况。

sentences.en: Michael, given those complications, can we actually just drill down on what Trump wants here, big picture?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，考虑到这些复杂因素，我们能否深入探讨一下特朗普在这里的大局目标是什么？

sentences.en: It's not as if Cuba has a ton to offer at the negotiating table with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 古巴在与美国的谈判桌上并没有太多筹码。

sentences.en: We know for Rubio, this is personal.
sentences.zh: 我们知道对卢比奥来说，这是私事。

sentences.en: But my impression is that outside of the large Cuban-American community in South Florida, not many Americans see toppling the Cuban regime as a huge priority.
sentences.zh: 但我的印象是，除了南佛罗里达庞大的古巴裔美国人社区外，并没有多少美国人认为推翻古巴政权是一个重大的优先事项。

sentences.en: So what does Trump care about here?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普在这里关心什么呢？

sentences.en: It's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: I think that most of the time, very few Americans are thinking about Cuba and don't really care that much about it.
sentences.zh: 我认为大多数时候，很少有美国人在考虑古巴，也不太关心它。

sentences.en: But having said that, I still think there's little doubt that if President Trump were to bring down the communist government of Cuba, implanted by Fidel Castro almost 70 years ago,
sentences.zh: 但话虽如此，我仍然认为毫无疑问，如果特朗普总统能够推翻菲德尔·卡斯特罗近70年前建立的古巴共产主义政府，

sentences.en: and he was able to do it without destroying Cuba along the way, I really think that that would be widely regarded around the world as kind of a historic triumph.
sentences.zh: 并且他能在不摧毁古巴的前提下做到这一点，我真的认为这将在世界范围内被广泛视为一种历史性的胜利。

sentences.en: He will have solved a foreign policy problem that many presidents before him were stymied by.
sentences.zh: 他将解决许多前任总统都束手无策的外交政策难题。

sentences.en: Going back to Dwight Eisenhower, and even those Americans who aren't thinking about Cuba 99.99% of the time,
sentences.zh: 追溯到德怀特·艾森豪威尔时期，即使是那些99.99%的时间里都不考虑古巴的美国人，

sentences.en: if they were to hear that there had been a breakthrough, that the communist government was stepping down or had paved the way for its own replacement in some credible way,
sentences.zh: 如果他们听说取得了突破，听说共产主义政府正在下台，或者以某种可信的方式为自己的更替铺平了道路，

sentences.en: I think it would have a real power.
sentences.zh: 我认为这将产生真正的力量。

sentences.en: Well, Michael, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 好的，迈克尔，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Monday, a federal judge ordered the Trump administration to temporarily restore displays
sentences.zh: 周一，一名联邦法官下令特朗普政府暂时恢复展示，

sentences.en: about George Washington's ownership of enslaved people at the site of his former house in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 关于乔治·华盛顿在费城故居拥有奴隶的内容。

sentences.en: Last month, National Park Service workers arrived at the site and took down displays and video exhibits describing the nine enslaved people
sentences.zh: 上个月，国家公园管理局的工作人员抵达现场，拆除了描述那九名奴隶的展示和视频展览，

sentences.en: Washington kept there while he was president.
sentences.zh: 那是华盛顿担任总统期间在那里蓄养的奴隶。

sentences.en: The Park Service said the displays were taken down to ensure, quote,
sentences.zh: 公园管理局称拆除这些展示是为了确保，引用原文，

sentences.en: In her order, the judge wrote that anyone who visits the president's house and doesn't learn about founding-era slavery would get a, quote, false account of this country's history.
sentences.zh: 法官在裁决书中写道，任何参观总统故居却不了解建国时期奴隶制的人，都会得到一份，引用原文，关于这个国家历史的虚假叙述。

sentences.en: And I love the smell of napalm in the morning.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢清晨汽油弹的味道。

sentences.en: It smells like victory.
sentences.zh: 那是胜利的味道。

sentences.zh: 演员罗伯特·杜瓦尔于周日去世，享年95岁。

sentences.zh: 他以饰演范围极广的主角和配角而闻名，从有原则的牛仔到黑手党顾问。

sentences.en: Now, nobody has ever gunned down a New York police captain, never.
sentences.zh: 听着，从来没有人枪杀过纽约警察局长，从来没有。

sentences.zh: 在他跨越六十多年的多产职业生涯中，

sentences.zh: 杜瓦尔获得了七次奥斯卡奖提名，并获奖一次。

sentences.en: I don't know why I wandered out to this part of Texas drunk and you took me in and pitied me and helped me to straighten out and marry me.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我喝醉了流浪到德克萨斯这片地方，你收留了我，同情我，还帮我改过自新并嫁给了我。

sentences.en: For his performance as a boozy, washed-up country star in Tender Mercies.
sentences.zh: 凭借他在《温柔的怜悯》中饰演的一位酗酒、落魄的乡村歌手的表演。

sentences.en: I never will.
sentences.zh: 我也永远不会信任。

sentences.zh: 他的标志性风格是如此深入地沉浸在每一个角色中，以至于他几乎变成了角色本身。

sentences.en: To prepare for his films, he spent time with police detectives, hung out with an ex-convict, and sang with a country band.
sentences.zh: 为了准备电影，他曾与警探共处，与前罪犯混在一起，并与乡村乐队一起唱歌。

sentences.en: This character's like Shakespeare, I think.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这个角色就像莎士比亚笔下的人物。

sentences.en: Duvall's own favorite role was none of his major big-screen characters.
sentences.zh: 杜瓦尔自己最喜欢的角色并不是他那些大银幕上的主要角色。

sentences.en: I said, let the English play Hamlet in King Lear.
sentences.zh: 我说，让英国人去演《哈姆雷特》和《李尔王》吧。

sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。
